verificationCriteria: When a Content Author opens a draft entry in the CMS live preview panel, the website page renders and displays the draft version of that entry's content fields.
When a Content Author modifies a field value on a draft entry in the CMS, the preview surface updates to show the modified value without requiring the entry to be published.
When a Content Author navigates to a different draft entry in the CMS, the preview surface renders the content of the newly selected draft entry.

notes: Live Preview does not exist in the codebase at all — no @contentstack/live-preview-utils dependency, no live_preview config on the Stack, no LivePreviewSDKProvider wrapper. The app uses Pages Router (src/pages/_app.tsx), but the vendor documentation only covers CSR App Router; the Pages Router integration path will need separate investigation. The Stack options object in src/services/contentstack.ts is the primary attachment point for SDK-level live_preview config. Custom preview URLs are a CMS admin configuration, not application code.
